entries.title: Docker
entries.description: Container runtime and orchestration via Docker Compose. Forms the foundation of the entire localai stack.

entries.title: Caddy
entries.description: Reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS via Let's Encrypt. Routes all external traffic to internal services.

entries.title: PostgreSQL
entries.description: Primary relational database used by Supabase, n8n, Langfuse, and Backstage for persistent data storage.

entries.title: Redis / Valkey
entries.description: In-memory key-value store used by Langfuse for caching and message queuing.

entries.title: ClickHouse
entries.description: Columnar analytics database powering Langfuse's observability data at scale.

entries.title: MinIO
entries.description: S3-compatible object storage used by Langfuse for event uploads and media storage.

entries.title: Supabase
entries.description: Open-source Firebase alternative providing Postgres, Auth, Storage, and Realtime APIs.

entries.title: Qdrant
entries.description: Vector similarity search engine for AI/ML embedding storage and retrieval (RAG pipelines).

entries.title: Ollama
entries.description: Local LLM inference server supporting multiple models. GPU-accelerated with NVIDIA/AMD support.

entries.title: Open WebUI
entries.description: Chat interface for interacting with Ollama models. Supports custom pipe functions for n8n integration.

entries.title: n8n
entries.description: Workflow automation platform. Central orchestrator for AI agent pipelines, webhook handling, and integrations.

entries.title: Langfuse
entries.description: LLM observability platform for tracing, evaluating, and monitoring AI application performance.

entries.title: Flowise
entries.description: Low-code agent builder with drag-and-drop UI. Connects to Ollama and n8n for visual AI workflow creation.

entries.title: Neo4j
entries.description: Graph database for knowledge graphs and relationship-heavy data models.

entries.title: SearXNG
entries.description: Privacy-focused metasearch engine providing web search capabilities to AI agents.
